# Timeline: every “Day N”

*Generated by `tools/build_extras.py` (run `python3 tools/ics.py build`). Do not edit by hand; it is overwritten on every build.*

Every “Day N” in the canon and story files, with the clock time when one follows it on the same line (Cycle 300 Q4 is one calendar). Times in the *Time* column are as written in each source, which does not always say whose clock. Lines that name another Cycle are left out, and so are 15 files whose Date header names another Cycle (C-06, C-26, 01 — Akar — Design Philosophy, 02 — Vance — Arrival Corridor Brief, 03 — Akar — Default Mode Threat, 04 — Ohm — Resistance Index Projections, 05 — Castile — Restroom Design Rationale, 06 — Akar — Year 1 Review, 07 — Brant — Board Observation Forwarded, 08 — Unknown — Unsent Draft, 10 — Akar — The Completion Rate, 11 — Vance — The Wording on the Growth Plan Form, 12 — Ohm — The Ten Per Cent and the Resistance Index, 13 — Akar — The Open Door, B-04). Mentions in `design/` are only counted. Not caught: times with no “Day” on the same line (C-21’s “scramble 02:44”) and ranges (“Days 11 to 20”).
